title: 손글씨와 인쇄체: 달라 보이는 글자 ㅈ ㅊ ㅎ ㅅ
objective: You can recognize ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅎ and ㅅ and read easy words with them.
summary: Learn to recognize ㅈ, ㅊ, ㅎ and ㅅ in print and in handwriting.

task.title: Read and recognize the letters
task.line: Use the shape and sound tips above to name each letter, choose the right word, or read the word aloud.

letters.as: Like j in 'jam', but softer. Print: a line over ㅅ. Handwriting: like 7 with a tail.
Like ch in 'church', with a puff of air. The top stroke can be a dot or a short line.
Like h in 'hat'. The top stroke can be a dot, a short down stroke or a flat line.
Like s in 'sun'. In handwriting, the right stroke often starts from the middle of the left stroke.

exercises: Name the letter from its shape: ① ㅈ with a dot or a short line on top ② ㅇ under a flat line, with a short stroke on top ③ a flat line with ㅅ under it
Use the romanization to fill in the missing syllable (시, 자, 추, 후): ① 고_ (gochu, chili pepper) ② _소 (siso, seesaw) ③ 오_ (ohu, afternoon)
The top stroke is hard to see. Use the romanization to choose the real word: ① tea (cha): 차 / 자 ② pants (baji): 바지 / 바치 ③ plum (jadu): 자두 / 사두
Read aloud and write the romanization: ① 하루 ② 수저 ③ 치즈
answers: ① ㅊ ② ㅎ ③ ㅈ
① 추 (고추) ② 시 (시소) ③ 후 (오후)
① 차 ② 바지 ③ 자두
① haru ② sujeo ③ chijeu
